device_identity_rule: Stable local profile IDs and private data namespaces; account:profiles carries portable fields only
activation: Authenticated and validated full-state pull before a new Harbor household is activated
first_account_import: Stage source sessions with a durable one-account claim, install roster aliases, bind/adopt the server, activate last
recovery: Keep the old local roster, sessions and shelves; retry partial staging without overwriting an existing destination record
other_accounts: Separate persisted households; no automatic source-session or personal-data import from a previously connected Harbor account
appearance_queue: Flush the earlier client's durable appearance intent before using the full roster writer; new edits use that writer only
failed_interface_retry: The app now reaches Anime; scroll the real LazyVStack before waiting for its initially offscreen continuation row
